digest.component_or_area: rebar search CLI and library interface
propositions: rebar search currently returns full TicketState including complete descriptions and all comment bodies, consuming excessive context (~203 KB) for discovery operations.
Default search output must project to eight bounded fields (ticket_id, alias, title, ticket_type, status, priority, summary, snippet) with summary and snippet each capped at 240 characters.

Summary field derives from stored summary if non-empty, else from normalized description, else null; snippet locates the first matching free-text term case-insensitively and returns a bounded context window from any matching field.

rebar search --full must preserve legacy full TicketState JSON array; rebar search --output llm must emit newline-delimited minified JSON with search_result_llm.schema.json contract; rebar search --output=<unknown> must exit 2.
rebar search --full --output=llm must exit 2 with incompatibility error; predicate-only and negation-only queries must return snippet: null.
Public library typing must distinguish summary-default SearchResult return type from full TicketState, and MCP search must advertise search_result.schema.json while show returns full bodies.
